runs.note: Quarterly manual checklist against the V2R1 benchmark. Only the rules that moved off Not Reviewed in this cycle are carried into the register; the rest of the 386-rule benchmark kept its prior answer.
First run on V2R3 after the July benchmark drop. The audit offload and account lockout rules answered Not a Finding for the first time in this cycle.
Current checklist of record for gcs-app-01. The audit offload rule answered Open again after the aggregator capacity change was rolled back on Aug 21.

Automated CKLB scoped to the RHEL 9.4 build rather than the chassis, which is how Evaluate-STIG reports. gcs-app-02 answers Not a Finding on GSSAPI where gcs-app-01 does not — the two application hosts have drifted apart.
Nightly SCAP run on the database host. One rule result carries a V-id in its idents but no CCI, so it is held for analyst mapping rather than guessed at.
Filesystem and sshd hardening subset run by the OS build pipeline. Scoped to the RHEL 9.4 kernel node, so its results land on the same part key as the gcs-app-02 and gcs-db-01 runs.

runs.benchmark: RHEL 9 DISA STIG audit file v2r3
runs.note: Credentialed sweep of the ground control segment with the DISA compliance audit file attached. The audit-file check RHEL-09-653080 reported the audit offload failing on gcs-db-01; the Aug 25 ACAS run no longer reports it, but the Aug 25 SCAP run still does against the same host, so FND-2240 is held open rather than queued for closure.

runs.benchmark: RHEL 9 DISA STIG audit file v2r3
runs.note: Current ACAS run of record. Plugin 71049 fires on gcs-app-01 for the same sshd_config setting the manual checklist already reports, which is what the duplicate reconciliation exists to catch.
Static analysis of the 2.14.0 tag. SonarQube asserts CWEs, not CCIs, so every issue here is held for analyst mapping — the pipeline reports what it could not resolve instead of guessing a control.

VEX statements against the BOM-0001 component list. One statement is not_affected with a real justification, one carries a KEV listing that overrides its CVSS, and one names a component that is in the image but not in the composition graph.
48-hour continuous fuzz across three harnesses ahead of TE-0044. Crash e5510b8d did not reproduce on replay and is floored at low rather than dropped.
Offline analysis of the extracted IOS-XE and ROMMON images. Every check reports against an image digest, so results land on the firmware node rather than the chassis.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 SSH daemon must not allow GSSAPI authentication.
native.findingDetails: grep -i gssapi /etc/ssh/sshd_config returns 'GSSAPIAuthentication yes'. The setting is present in the running configuration and survives an sshd reload.
native.comments: Kerberos single sign-on was enabled for the operator group in 2024 and never retired after the PIV rollout.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must offload audit records onto a different system in real time.
native.findingDetails: rsyslog omfwd is configured to the aggregator but the disk-assisted queue drains on a 36-hour cycle, so records reach the aggregator well outside the defined window.
native.comments: Aggregator ingest capacity is the constraint, not the forwarder configuration.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must implement a FIPS 140-3 approved cryptographic module.
native.findingDetails: fips-mode-setup --check reports 'FIPS mode is disabled.' and /proc/sys/crypto/fips_enabled reads 0.
native.comments: Host was rebuilt on Jul 18 from an image that predates the FIPS kickstart change.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must automatically lock an account when three unsuccessful logon attempts occur.
native.findingDetails: faillock deny is set to 5 in /etc/security/faillock.conf, above the organization-defined limit of 3.
native.comments: Value inherited from the pre-migration Ansible role.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must be a vendor-supported release.
native.findingDetails: cat /etc/redhat-release reports 'Red Hat Enterprise Linux release 9.4 (Plow)', inside the vendor support window until May 2032.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 SSH daemon must not allow GSSAPI authentication.
native.findingDetails: GSSAPIAuthentication yes is still present in /etc/ssh/sshd_config. The Ansible drift job does not manage this key.
native.comments: Tracked under POAM-0071; the golden sshd baseline change is scheduled for Sep.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must implement a FIPS 140-3 approved cryptographic module.
native.findingDetails: fips-mode-setup --check still reports FIPS mode disabled. Enabling it requires a reboot that has not been scheduled inside a maintenance window.
native.comments: Change request CHG-4471 raised on Aug 05.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must have the auditd service enabled and active.
native.findingDetails: systemctl is-active auditd returns 'inactive'. The service failed to start after the Aug 09 kernel update and no alert fired.
native.comments: New rule in V2R3; this host was not evaluated against it before Aug 13.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must offload audit records onto a different system in real time.
native.findingDetails: Measured spool drain across three cycles after the Aug 07 aggregator capacity increase averaged 9 hours, inside the 24-hour statement.
native.comments: Re-tested against the same procedure used on Jul 30.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must automatically lock an account when three unsuccessful logon attempts occur.
native.findingDetails: faillock deny now reads 3 and unlock_time 0; a fourth failed attempt locked the test account as expected.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 SSH daemon must not allow GSSAPI authentication.
native.findingDetails: sshd_config sets GSSAPIAuthentication yes, allowing a non-PIV authentication path to a privileged interface. Confirmed against the running daemon with sshd -T.
native.comments: Bastion-only reachability limits who can reach the interface but does not change what the interface accepts.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must have the auditd service enabled and active.
native.findingDetails: systemctl is-active auditd still returns 'inactive'. The unit is enabled but exits 1 on start because /var/log/audit is out of inodes.
native.comments: Blocked on the separate audit partition change tracked by V-258066.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must offload audit records onto a different system in real time.
native.findingDetails: Spool drain measured at 31 hours on Aug 26. The Aug 07 aggregator capacity increase was rolled back on Aug 21 during the storage incident and was never re-applied.
native.comments: Answered Not a Finding on Aug 13; the condition has returned.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must allocate audit record storage capacity on a separate file system.
native.findingDetails: findmnt /var/log/audit returns no separate mount; audit records share the root file system with application logs.
native.comments: First evaluation of this rule on gcs-app-01.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must implement a FIPS 140-3 approved cryptographic module.
native.findingDetails: fips-mode-setup --check reports 'FIPS mode is enabled.' after the Aug 22 maintenance reboot; /proc/sys/crypto/fips_enabled reads 1.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must be a vendor-supported release.
native.findingDetails: Release 9.4 (Plow) is inside the vendor support window until May 2032.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must initiate a session lock after 15 minutes of inactivity.
native.findingDetails: tmux lock-after-time is unset for the operator group; a 30-minute idle test on an interactive shell did not lock the session.
native.comments: Physical access to the console is limited to a controlled facility.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 SSH daemon must not allow GSSAPI authentication.
native.findingDetails: sshd -T reports gssapiauthentication no. gcs-app-02 was rebuilt on Aug 04 from the hardened image that sets the key explicitly.
native.comments: The same rule is Open on gcs-app-01 — the two application hosts have drifted apart.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must have the auditd service enabled and active.
native.findingDetails: systemctl is-active auditd returns 'inactive'. Same failure mode as gcs-app-01 after the Aug 09 kernel update.
native.comments: Fleet-wide condition on the RHEL 9.4 build, not a per-host misconfiguration.

native.ruleTitle: RHEL 9 must not have the telnet-server package installed.
native.findingDetails: The minimal build excludes the telnet-server package entirely; rpm -q telnet-server returns 'package telnet-server is not installed'.
native.comments: Marked Not Applicable per the benchmark's own applicability statement.
